mode.description: Which mode the `vehicles` figures should cover. Omitted, they cover every mode together. Frontline, Onslaught and Steel Hunter are absent on purpose: Wargaming publishes no per-vehicle statistics for them at all, so a client in one of those battles omits this and reads the whole record.

vehicles.description: `<account id>:<vehicle id>` pairs, up to 60. Each one is answered in `vehicles` with what that account has done on that vehicle. The vehicle id is Wargaming's `tank_id`, which is the game client's own compact descriptor, so a client reads it off the roster it is drawing.
